operation.description:
Read operation. Retrieve all required pages before reporting complete totals. Returns a single branch by id.

This is a v2 native-entity endpoint served from the `/v2/api/entity` base and authenticated with a Bearer token. **Requires the Branches plugin to be enabled on the account.**

The trailing path segment (`1`) is the **data level** — how deeply related records are loaded — not a page number; on this endpoint it has no visible effect. The response is a flat branch record.

This API exposes six branch fields only — `id`, `name`, `status`, `created`, `modified`, and `code`. Other branch attributes (phone numbers, address, city, state, country, assigned staff, SMTP account, map location) are **not** available through this endpoint.

The `status` value is one of:

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `1` | Active |
| `2` | Inactive |
| `3` | Suspended |
